Question: I want to know that many peoples doing qurbani on 4day of idul azha.is this correct plz mention with reference of hadith. Answer ID: 3971 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 118/118=M) Qurbani can be performed only within three days; tenth, eleventh and twelfth of Zulhij, and that too is also till sunset of twelfth, there is no qurbani after sunset. So, in the abovementioned case, qurbani in no way is lawful on fourth day of Eidul Azha: وقت الاضحیۃ ثلاثۃ ایام العاشر والحادی عشر و الثانی عشر، و یجوز فی نھارھا و لیلھا بعد طلوع الفجر من یوم النحر الی غروب الشمس من الیوم الثانی عشر الخ ( عالم گیری: 5/295 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
